specification: LIP-v1 Audit Rules - Lumina Implementation Program

rules.description: Domain modules must never import from infrastructure/ directly. All infrastructure dependencies must be resolved via port interfaces (Dependency Inversion per DOC-000 Rule 4 + DOC-004 PONT 12).
rules.exception: Port interface definitions (*.port.ts or *-ports.ts files within domains/*/ports/) are allowed.

rules.description: No any type allowed per ITS-v1 NB-TECH-002 strict mode. All types must be explicitly defined.
rules.exception: None. This is a NeverBreak rule.

rules.description: Every database query (find, findAll, findOne, findByIds) must include org_id filter for multi-tenant isolation per DOC-023 Section 8 NB-MT-002.
rules.check: every find/query method in domain services must reference context.orgId or this.orgId for filtering
rules.exception: Query methods on superadmin-only system tables may exclude org_id with inline comment explaining why.

rules.description: No hardcoded secrets, credentials, API keys, or tokens. Secrets come from Key Manager / environment variables only. Per SEC-SPEC-005 Section 2.4.
rules.exception: *.env.template files are allowed (but not .env with real values). Test fixtures using mock data are excluded if in __tests__/ or test-fixtures/ directories.

rules.description: Audit entries are append-only immutable. DELETE and UPDATE operations must never be called on audit_entries or audit_logs tables.
rules.check: audit service methods must never call repository.delete() or repository.update() on audit entry collections
rules.exception: Automated retention purge process (scheduled job) may hard-delete entries past retention_expires_at, but each deletion must itself be logged to admin_operational_log table.

rules.description: UI strings must use i18next t('key') pattern. No hardcoded French or English text in React components.
rules.exception: Test files (*.test.tsx, *.spec.tsx) can use hardcoded strings for clarity. Empty strings and single-character strings are ignored.

rules.description: No console.log or console.error calls. Use NestJS Logger exclusively.
rules.exception: CLI entry points (src/main.ts, scripts/*.ts) may use console for user-facing output.

rules.description: No @ts-ignore directives. All type errors must be fixed at source.
All database entities must have UUID primary key, org_id FK with CASCADE delete, created_at, updated_at columns.
rules.check: every entity class and every Prisma model must declare @PrimaryColumn(type: uuid) or equivalent, @Column({ name: org_id, nullable: false }), @CreateDateColumn(), @UpdateDateColumn()
rules.exception: Junction tables with composite PK replace uuid PK with composite key. AuditAggregate entries have auto-incrementing sequence number instead of UUID.

rules.description: All domain events must implement DomainEvent interface with aggregateId, eventType, timestamp fields. Events emitted after every state change.
rules.check: every event class must extend or implements DomainEvent base and contain aggregateId: string, eventType: string, timestamp: Date
rules.exception: Internal system events (purely infra-level like HealthCheckCompleted) may omit aggregateId.

rules.description: Hex color values must follow pattern ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$ and be sourced from ConfigurationAggregate settings, never hardcoded.
rules.exception: Color definitions in design token/theme files are allowed (e.g., src/**/theme.ts, src/**/design-tokens.ts).

rules.description: All resource state transitions must go through a StateTransitionValidator - no direct state mutation allowed.
rules.check: service methods changing entity.status/state must call validateTransition(oldState, newState) before persisting
rules.exception: System bootstrap creates initial records with default states (no transition validation needed for first write).

rules.description: All versioned resources must increment persist_version on every write. Optimistic concurrency check required.
rules.check: UPDATE queries must include WHERE version = <current_version> and increment version by 1 on success
rules.exception: Append-only tables (audit_entries) do not have a version field. Config settings are mutable without version tracking.

rules.description: Audit entries old_values / new_values must NEVER contain password hashes, refresh_token_hash, encryption keys, or raw tokens. Per SEC-SPEC-004 Section 8.
rules.check: audit logging must exclude fields: password_hash, salt, refresh_token_hash, device_fingerprint_hash, raw_token_value
rules.exception: None. This is a security critical rule.

rules.description: Every generated artifact must contain IGS-v1 metadata header: generation_id, source_canonical, transformation_rule, architecture_version, compliance_status.
rules.check: first comment block or JSDoc of every generated file must contain metadata tags
rules.exception: README.md files and configuration files (docker-compose.yml, .env.template) are exempt.

rules.description: Polymorphic references must store BOTH resource_type AND resource_id together (never just one). Entity types must be from an enumerated set.
rules.check: whenever a record has resource_id, it must also have resource_type; resource_type must match one of: transaction, member, event, archive_entry

rules.description: Offline sync pending operations queue must never exceed batch size of 50 per push. Exponential backoff retry max 5 attempts.
rules.check: PushCoordinator must slice operations into batches of <=50; retry logic must use 1000*2^n ms delays capped at 5 retries
rules.exception: Unit tests may simulate larger batches.

rules.description: Approved transactions must never be modified. Corrections must use compensating transactions with compensates_for field linking to original.
rules.check: UPDATE on transactions table where status=approved must be blocked; compensation creates NEW transaction with type=compensation and compensates_for=original_id

severity_levels.CRITICAL: Must be fixed before merging. Blocks deployment pipeline.
severity_levels.MAJOR: Must be fixed before release. High priority remediation.
severity_levels.MINOR: Should be fixed. Tracked in sprint backlog.
severity_levels.BLOCKING: Violates NeverBreak rules. Zero tolerance. Immediate fix required.
